title: A Confession for the Verdict
author: Coral Reyes
blurb: Orsen Voss, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
